description: This source file contains unit tests for the PolicyCommandEnforcement component within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement package. It tests policy creation, modification, retrieval, and cache behavior using the Akka testing framework and mocks related to policies, authorization, and enforcement logic.

classes.name: PolicyCommandEnforcementTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PolicyCommandEnforcement, testing policy creation, modification, retrieval, cache behavior, and permission checks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Akka ActorSystem, test probes, cache, and enforcer actor before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: createPoliciesShardRegionProbe
methods.description: Creates a test probe simulating the policies shard region.

methods.name: createEnforcer
methods.description: Creates and returns the enforcer actor with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: createUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique actor name with a given prefix.

methods.name: createCache
methods.description: Creates a Caffeine cache with specified loader.

methods.description: Asserts that actual and expected RetrievePolicyResponse objects are equivalent.

methods.description: Creates a default mock response for a retrieved policy.
